modules.directive: Preserve truthfulness, require operator verification of identity and financial inputs, and block external action.
Prepare formal Canadian public-sector draft prose without representing placeholders as verified facts.
Run research, drafting, financial review, and red-team review in sequence.
Use only locally approved, rights-reviewed historical materials and cite their source metadata.
Validate explicit funding ceilings, matching ratios, page limits, and project constraints supplied with the opportunity.
Identify technical trade-offs for review without inventing experimental results.
Index approved local text using deterministic local retrieval; do not upload records to third parties.
Track only discovered, review-required, drafted, audited, and approval-pending states.
Treat Cloud Run deployment as a separately governed, fail-closed production concern.
Produce reviewable executive-summary, work-breakdown, and impact-metric templates with evidence placeholders.
Keep remote portal retrieval disabled until scoped Phase 5 approval and connector review are recorded.
Record dependency, data-rights, and policy-review requirements before enabling additional capabilities.
Flag unsupported claims, unverified rules, missing evidence, and logical gaps for human review.
Retain only governed, non-sensitive outcome metadata and never change behavior without approval.
Compile an internal draft package and a manual handoff checklist; never create a portal submission payload.
